say: Good morning, {PLAYER}. Thank you for coming.
As you know, the city has been... restless. Lakes foaming, trees vanishing overnight.
The Urumon feel it before we do. I need young eyes out there, and Urumon partners to keep you safe.
On that table are three Urumon. Each one is yours to raise. Go on, choose your partner.
script.speaker: Prof. Sharada

script.say: Wait, Grandma! Why does {PLAYER} get to choose first?

script.say: Then I'll take {RIVAL_STARTER}! It's the best one anyway. Obviously.
script.speaker: Sudeep

script.say: Okay {PLAYER}, let's see whose Urumon is stronger! Best of one - no rematches!

onWin.say: What?! I picked the wrong one... no! I just need practice!

onLose.say: Ha! Did you see that?! Sudeep, future Champion of Bengaluru!

say: Splendid! Your partners already trust you.

script.speaker: Prof. Sharada

script.say: And these steel Dabbas. Weaken a wild Urumon, then toss a Dabba to catch it.
script.speaker: Prof. Sharada

say: There are six Arena Leaders across the city. Earn their badges, and the Namma Council at Vidhana Soudha will take you seriously.
And keep your eyes open. Something is wrong with this city, and I mean to find out what.
script.speaker: Prof. Sharada

script.say: Six badges? I'll get them first! Bye, Grandma! Bye, slowpoke!
script.speaker: Sudeep
